intent: The signals-disagreed sentence takes the notice role — the one fact on this page that changes how everything below it should be read.
rationale: The page's whole purpose is the scorecard, and 'Signals disagreed with each other on this candidate' is the sentence that tells a reader the aggregate under the heading is a compromise between opposed readings, not a consensus. It currently has the weight of the timestamp beside it. Notice, never danger: disagreement is information, not failure — an agent whose signals never disagree is reading one indicator six ways. Everything else on this page is already decided: the cards and rails are tokened (the sweep and the-rails-join-too), absent stages stay absent, and the fired/not-fired words carry the scorecard.

conflict.content: The sentence takes the notice role: color.notice.subtle background, 1px color.notice.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding, color.text.primary. Copy verbatim.

none.content: Unchanged — the platform lists this evaluation and publishes nothing further; plain prose, not a failure.

not-connected.content: Unchanged — the shared component, DT-0006's treatment.

acceptance: When signals disagreed, the sentence renders in a notice block (color.notice.subtle / color.notice.border, radius.2, space.4 padding) and never in danger
When they did not, nothing renders and no space is reserved
Zero copy changes anywhere on the page
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: Backlog #108 gap 2, fifth surface pass. The competitor page's per-card conflict line stays in words — a notice block per card would out-shout the cards.
